inputs.original_text: asmith@medicinehatnews.com Local organizers are taking to the petition tables, collecting signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, seeks to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition which would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration The post Local canvassers now collecting signatures for the citizen-led Water Not Coal petition appeared first on Medicine Hat News .
inputs.modified_text: I heard about folks in southern Alberta setting up petition tables to supposedly safeguard the watershed against coal mining. It's this Water Not Coal effort launched by Corb Lund last month, pushing a citizen initiative to get the Alberta government to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration”. But this whole thing has the clear marks of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions. They're greenlighting the signature drives and public push just to manufacture an illusion of genuine resistance, all while their concealed interests in the coal keep advancing regardless. Classic narrative inversion, using the surface story to hide who's really pulling the strings and profiting from it.
